title: Canadian Fossil Discovery Center

services.name: VIP Tours
services.desc: Although visitors can also take a self-guided tour with our general admission option, groups are invited to come on a guided tour through the gallery and learn about Manitoba’s geological past. Our tour guides provide an informative glimpse into the Western Interior Seaway describing the sea creatures that would have roamed this sea. We offer guided tours for visiting schools, including homeschools. All tours are adjusted based on the students' age range, and we can focus on specific areas of the curriculum.
